g.title: (a) Exemplar-based Methods
g.desc: Top-left frame contains three sequential model blocks, dataset labels above, memory buffer below, update/store/replace arrows, and a memory image icon at the buffer origin. The arrangement is horizontal left-to-right with vertical links to the buffer.

g.title: (b) Prototype-based Methods
g.desc: Top-right frame contains two model trapezoids, a prototype bank, dataset labels, snow/fire domain markers, retrieval/extract/update arrows, and class centroid dots. The section is symmetric around the retrieval direction between the two models.

g.title: (c) Ours: Prompt-Anchored visual-text Distillation
g.desc: Bottom frame contains a shared-space dashed area above and two lower dashed areas for text side and visual side. Text prompts and visual prompts each rise from dataset arrows, interact with intermediate expert trapezoids, and connect upward to central prompt anchors. Prompt anchors align with the visual branch through a right-side connector. The layout is divided by horizontal dashed guides and left-right symmetry between text and visual sides, with distinct blue/red domains.
